usedFor: PayHere holds payments and Google Contacts holds your address book, so “Payment Received” can run “Create Contact” for each payer.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Paying customers land in your address book without retyping, ready for later follow-up.

watchOut: “Payment Received” fires on every payment, so a repeat buyer can run “Create Contact” again.
